scenes.title: Why does checkout keep spinning?
scenes.label: CUSTOMER PROBLEM
scenes.voice: Asha's checkout times out. Platform threads stay occupied waiting for responses. When the request thread pool fills, new shoppers queue.
scenes.note: The server can be short of threads even with spare CPU.

cues.text: Platform threads stay occupied waiting for responses.

scenes.title: Virtual threads help more requests progress
scenes.label: HOW JAVA 21 HELPS
scenes.voice: Virtual threads are lightweight. During supported network waits, Java frees the underlying operating system thread for other requests. More checkouts can progress together.
scenes.status: Pause waiting request → reuse carrier → resume
scenes.note: Like a waiter helping another table while food cooks.

cues.text: During supported network waits, Java frees the underlying
operating system thread for other requests.

scenes.title: The kitchen still has a limit
scenes.label: DEPENDENCY CAPACITY
scenes.voice: This helps when threads were the bottleneck. Payment is not faster. Twenty database connections still allow only twenty connections at once.
scenes.note: Illustrative limits; no measured speedup is claimed.

scenes.title: One checkout, one payment identity
scenes.label: MAKE RETRIES SAFE
scenes.voice: Save one payment attempt. Repeated clicks reuse its reference. A timeout does not prove payment failed.
scenes.note: A changed payload with the same key is a conflict.

cues.text: A timeout does not prove payment failed.

scenes.title: Protect the systems doing the work
scenes.label: BOUNDED CALLS + BACKPRESSURE
scenes.voice: A bulkhead bounds active calls and waiting work. Give busy guidance only before payment starts. Keep database transactions short.
scenes.status: 20 active · 10 waiting · excess work gets busy guidance
scenes.note: A bulkhead is a bounded waiting room for a dependency.

cues.text: A bulkhead bounds active calls and waiting work.
Give busy guidance only before payment starts.

scenes.title: Timeout? Check the original payment
scenes.label: HONEST STATUS + RECOVERY
scenes.voice: Set network deadlines. For uncertain payment, show checking and query the original provider reference before confirming. Never blindly pay again.
scenes.status: UNKNOWN → lookup original reference → verified result
scenes.note: A local timeout may leave remote work running.

scenes.title: Efficient waiting. Safer checkout.
scenes.label: THE COMPLETE IMPROVEMENT
scenes.voice: Virtual threads improve waiting efficiency. Capacity limits protect dependencies. Safe recovery protects Asha's payment. Checkout needs all three.
scenes.status: Concurrency + capacity protection + safe payment recovery
scenes.note: Article, simulation and video follow this same story.
